mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM homework WHERE class_id=#{classId} AND homework_date=#{homeworkDate}
SELECT hs.*,s.student_name,s.student_phone FROM homework_submission hs JOIN student s ON s.id=hs.student_id WHERE hs.homework_id=#{homeworkId} ORDER BY hs.submit_time DESC
SELECT * FROM homework_submission WHERE homework_id=#{homeworkId} AND student_id=#{studentId}

SELECT h.id,h.title,h.homework_date,h.class_content,h.deadline,h.content_file_name,h.content_object_key, h.answer_student_visible AS answer_visible, CASE WHEN h.answer_student_visible=1 THEN h.answer_file_name END answer_file_name, CASE WHEN h.answer_student_visible=1 THEN h.answer_object_key END answer_object_key, CASE WHEN hs.id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END submitted,hs.content_file_name submission_file_name, hs.submit_time,hs.late_submitted,hs.score,hs.teacher_remark FROM homework h LEFT JOIN homework_submission hs ON hs.homework_id=h.id AND hs.student_id=#{studentId} WHERE h.class_id=#{classId} AND h.start_time<=#{now} ORDER BY h.homework_date DESC,h.id DESC
